title: PushButtonTools conversion and pricing follow-up packet

checks.question: Do the solve pages clearly point interested users toward the pricing page?
checks.evidence_needed: Local or live page screenshots, URL list, and CTA text examples.

checks.question: Are Pro CTA clicks being tracked with a recognizable event name?
checks.evidence_needed: Database/schema proof or logged analytics event examples.

checks.question: Does the upgrade copy avoid fake income claims and overpromising?
checks.evidence_needed: Copy excerpts from pricing and solve pages.

checks.question: Do pricing and solve pages render without obvious mobile overflow?
checks.evidence_needed: Mobile viewport screenshot or browser inspection notes.

checks.question: Can a visitor understand the problem, see the recommended next step, and reach the pricing page without confusion?
checks.evidence_needed: Manual walkthrough notes for 3 representative solve pages.

checks.question: Are all live changes, commits, pushes, outreach, and publishing still blocked until Chris approves?
checks.evidence_needed: Confirm no external action was performed.
